families.description: Centralized governance control-plane architecture, parity, topology, and bounded governed AI activation work.

families.label: Enterprise Cybersecurity Baseline
families.description: Workspace-wide cybersecurity control baseline, assurance, and compliance operating-model work.

families.label: Delivery ART Governance Foundations
families.description: Machine-readable ART model, taxonomy, and projection-governance work that keeps the delivery plane structurally truthful.

families.label: Delivery ART Operator Surfaces
families.description: Delivery workflow operator path, consume-to-planning flow, and admin-surface hardening for ART execution.

families.label: Product And Prototype Delivery
families.description: Fast governed incubation, prototype, internal product, and client app delivery lane work before graduation into governed product delivery or a dedicated product repository.

families.label: Devint Smoke
families.description: Smoke, rehearsal, or temporary validation initiatives that exist to prove a runtime or workflow path.

roles.label: Architecture Anchor
roles.description: Defines the top-level architecture truth for one initiative family.

roles.label: Prerequisite Foundation
roles.description: Lands a required foundation tranche beneath an existing architecture anchor.

roles.label: Topology Decision
roles.description: Captures a structural topology or extraction decision after an upstream gate.

roles.label: Bounded Activation
roles.description: Activates one bounded consumer or runtime tranche behind the anchor and explicit upstream gate.

roles.label: Control Hardening
roles.description: Hardens one existing initiative family or operator surface without redefining the architecture anchor.

roles.label: Operational Smoke
roles.description: Temporary smoke or rehearsal initiative that proves runtime or workflow reachability without becoming an architecture chain.

quality_gates.rule: A top-level initiative may remain unclassified only while it is a new Initiating shell without Target PI. Planning or committed initiatives must carry Initiative Family and Lineage Role.
The declared Lineage Role controls whether Architecture Anchor Ref and Required Upstream Ref are mandatory.
Architecture Anchor Ref must point to an existing top-level Epic when present.
A non-anchor initiative must share Initiative Family with its declared Architecture Anchor Ref.
Required Upstream Ref must point to an existing ART work package when present.
